attribute_plan.note: H1 records front plus rear, left and right from outside; RivalB3 N5 and RivalB4 VisionPano 40 spend their four channels on cabin cameras, so the exterior four-side story is a published brand lead.
All three brands offer parking mode with a hardwire kit; the official page contradicts itself on whether the kit is needed, which is a one-page fix.
Buyers ask whether parking mode needs extra equipment and whether it drains the battery; the brand sells the hardwire kit but does not answer the drain question on the product page.
Buyers name Sony STARVIS 2; the brand page only says 'enhanced low-light capture' and names no sensor, so the position cannot be settled from the public layer.
Bbrand lists a 1-year warranty against RivalB4's 24 months; the term is a policy gap content cannot close, so it is carried inside the category Topic rather than getting its own Topic.
Front 3K beats N5 (2.7K) and VisionPano 40 (2.5K) on paper, but the sensor part number is unpublished.
Tool-free magnetic snap-on mount; competitors use adhesive mounts. Demand for DIY install is partly inferred from the accessory question Q02.
128GB included, 512GB maximum, same ceiling as RivalB4; matters most for long parking capture.
Supercapacitor rated -20 C to 70 C; RivalB3 N5 also uses a supercapacitor, so the claim is parity plus a published temperature range.
Buyers frame budgets at $100 and $200 while H1 sells at $209; price is a business lever, not a content lever.
Buyers cite faulty-unit and poor-service reports about another brand and doubt good review scores; no public reliability data for the brand was collected.

attribute_plan.no_carrier_reason: The H1 records the exterior only; rideshare and cabin-coverage buyers fall outside the Case's applicability boundary and are served by the competitors' cabin-channel models, so no Prompt is written.
Raised once as one item on a buyer checklist (Q06); it does not decide the candidate set and no independent Prompt is justified.
Parity feature across the frozen set with no buyer-language evidence behind it; it stays in the pool for the client to disagree with but carries no Prompt.
